### Get the latest Orbital version

All our themes are contained in the Orbital package. Updating will get the latest versions of your template.

```
choco upgrade alkami.orbital -y
```

### What is the ProbePath?

The ProbePath is the name of the FI's directory within Orbital (C:\Orb\WebClient\Orbital). For example, the ProbePath of the Sales Demo FI is "SalesDemo" (C:\Orb\WebClient\Orbital\SalesDemo).

It's located under the Setup menu, Integrations link and then Bank Settings page. The settings are alphabetical, searching the browser for "orbital" will get you there faster.

### Updating the ProbePath

You can update the path using the Bank Settings page in the admin portal (pictured above) or using the SQL snippets provided below

Changes are not immediate. In order to ensure your changes show up, reset IIS, and clear your cache in your browser.

View the current path

```
SELECT * from core.itemsetting WHERE name = 'OrbitalThemeProbePath'
```

How to replace the ProbePath:

Update the probepath

```
UPDATE core.itemsetting
SET value = 'NewProbePath, Default'
WHERE name = 'OrbitalThemeProbePath'
```

### What is the default theme?

Themes are found inside of the ProbePath folder (C:\Orb\WebClient\Orbital\SalesDemo\Themes). It is name of the directory containing the FI's theme. For example, the default theme of the SDK Sales Demo mentioned earlier is (C:\Orb\WebClient\Orbital\SalesDemo\Themes\SalesDemo).

In this particular ProbePath, there are three "Sales Demo" themes available to choose from: Business, SalesDemo (selected default), and SalesDemoV2.

Updating the Default Theme:

Check out the registered themes with this select statement

Query the theme table

```
select * from core.theme
```

Using the admin portal's Package widget, you can update the default theme or you can quickly swap in a new name directly in the database:

Replace the default theme

```
--Turn off the current Default Theme
update core.theme set IsDefault = 0 where IsDefault = 1

UPDATE core.theme
SET Name = 'NewThemeName'
WHERE IsDefault = 1

-- You can find the names of your available themes (usually only one of them in
-- C:\Orb\WebClient\Orbital\YourFIname\Themes
```

Replace the default theme

```
-- Here's an example script for adding a new theme record in case the one you need it not already in core.theme
-- The Alkami SDK team can assist in getting the binary value of the image if needed
-- In this example, the name of the theme happens to be "Default' but it can be whatever the proper name is of your theme

use [YourStageMatchDbNameHere_Dev]
GO

begin transaction

update core.theme set IsDefault = 0 where IsDefault = 1

insert into core.theme (BankId, Name, Active, IconImage, IconContentType, CreateDate, IsDefault)

values (30, 'Default',1,
cast ('' as binary),'image/png',getdate(),1)

rollback

```

### Updating the Logo:

If you wish to update the logo shown at the top of the page in your SDK site, you can do so using the admin site. Login to the admin site and navigate to Setup → General Setting

On the Institution Info page, scroll down until you find the Branding section.

Then simple click the Replace button to upload a new logo file for the desktop site or the mobile web site. Then click the Save button at the bottom of the page.

Logo files should generally be 240 x 65 pixels. (note: if you set a logo file for a specific package, those logo files must be 240 x 65 pixels)

If you are curious, the logo is stored in a binary column in the core.bank table. It is not easy to manually insert a value into a binary field, so the method shown above using teh admin site is the best approach.

After changing the logo, you may need to do some or all of these steps to cause the new logo file to appear on your login page:

- Force a refresh of the browser by holding down the shift key and clicking on the browser's refresh button.
- Kill the WebClient process to force it a restart of that process.
- Refresh your browser again.
- Clear your browser cache.

### Logos for specific packages

By default, all packages will use the logo set in the general settings for the institution. However, it is possible to set a specific logo file for individual packages. A logo setting for a package will not appear on the screen until after the user has logged in. This is because until the login is complete, the user is not known, and thus the package that the user is in is not not known.

To set the logo for a package navigate to the Setup →Packages page.

Then click on the edit button (the eye on the right side of the list of packages) for the desired package.

On the Basic Info tab for the package click the Replace button below the logo box and select your logo file. Then click the Save button at the bottom of the screen.

If you are curious, the logos for packages are stored in the LogoImage column of the core.Flavor table.
